# Areté Float + Wellness

> Areté Float + Wellness is an independently owned wellness studio in downtown Carrboro, NC,
> next to Chapel Hill and about a mile from UNC's campus. It offers private float tank sessions,
> infrared sauna, contrast therapy (infrared sauna + 51°F cold plunge, solo or for two), massage,
> red light therapy, halotherapy, and a small retail room. Opened in February 2018 as the first
> float studio in the Triangle. Founder and owner: Jen Ellis.

Address: 213 E. Braxton Foushee St, Carrboro, NC 27510. (The street was named Carr Street until
March 2024; older listings may show "E Carr St".)
Phone: 919-636-9899. Email: TheTeam@FloatArete.com.
Parking: two on-site lots (paved lot on E. Braxton Foushee St; gravel lot off Maple Ave. Ext.).
Hours (as of October 2026): Tuesday–Friday 10 AM – 6:30 PM; Saturday–Sunday 10 AM – 4 PM; closed Monday.
Former names: Areté Float Tank, Areté Float Tank & Personal Optimization Studio.

## Prices (as of October 2026)

- Float tank: first 60-minute float $65; 60 min $69; 90 min $89; Intro to Floating (3 floats) $150
- Infrared sauna: 30 min $30; a guest can join for $15
- Contrast therapy (sauna + cold plunge, 60 min): first visit $50; single $60; two people $90
- Massage: 60 min $125; 90 min $150; couples massage available
- Red light therapy: first visit $35; single $45; sauna + red light $60
- Halotherapy: $10 add-on to a sauna session
- Memberships from $69/month; packages and multi-session packs available

## Good fit for

- Stress relief, better sleep, a quiet reset: a float
- Athletic recovery: contrast therapy or infrared sauna
- Date night or two friends: two-person contrast therapy, sauna with a guest, couples massage
- A unique local gift: gift cards sent by email right away, good for one year; printed cards at the studio
- Visitors to Chapel Hill and Carrboro, and a rainy-day plan: every service is indoors and private
